caption.text: Part 3 of KAFKA RETENTION & COMPACTION. Your Kafka topic says 1-hour retention and the disk holds 8 hours — that is not a bug, it is `segment.ms` plus the sweep interval plus the delete delay. This field handbook walks the whole machinery: segment files as the real unit of deletion, why `retention.bytes` is per-partition (and how that turns 10 GB into 360 GB), how the log cleaner silently stalls when one segment holds more keys than its 128 MB dedupe buffer, and why a tombstone your consumer slept through leaves a phantom key forever. Ten pages of production-grade notes on the one policy that decides what data you keep.
